Number.description: Unique number of the customer (max 19 digits).

Title.description:
Title of the customer.

Mister (Mr.)

Miss (Ms.)

Misses (Mrs.)

Sex.description:
Sex of the customer.

Male

Female

SecondLastName.description: Second last name of the customer.

PreferredLanguageCode.description: Language and culture code of the customer's preferred language, according to their profile. For example: `en-GB`, `fr-CA`.

LanguageCode.description: Language and culture code of the customer's language, based on multiple sources. These sources include the preferred language specified in internal data based on previous bookings, and the preferred language of the customer specified in their profile. If neither of these sources are present, we use the native language based on the customer's nationality. The format is, for example, `en-US` or `fr-FR`.

BirthDate.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format.

BirthCountryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the birth country.

BirthCountrySubdivisionCode.description: ISO 3166-2 code of the administrative division, e.g. ES-C.

HasOtaEmail.description: Whether the customer's email address is a temporary email address from an OTA. For more details, see the [product documentation](https://help.mews.com/s/article/how-to-maintain-ota-guest-profiles-with-verified-email-addresses-obtained-from-the-guest-portal).

Phone.description: Phone number of the customer (possibly mobile).

TaxIdentificationNumber.description: Tax identification number of the customer.

CarRegistrationNumber.description: Registration number of the customer's car.

DietaryRequirements.description: Customer's dietary requirements, e.g. Vegan, Halal.

CreatedUtc.description: Creation date and time of the customer in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

UpdatedUtc.description: Last update date and time of the customer in UTC timezone in ISO 8601 format.

AddressId.description: Unique identifier of the `Address` of the customer.

CompanyId.description: Unique identifier of [Company](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/companies/#company) the customer is associated with.

MergeTargetId.description: Unique identifier of the account ([Customer](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/#customer)) to which this customer is linked.

ActivityState.description: [Activity State](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/operations/#activity-state) of customer record, i.e. whether active or deleted.

IsActive.description: Whether the customer record is still active.

PreferredSpaceFeatures.description: A list of room preferences, such as view type, bed type, and amenities.

CreatorProfileId.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the customer.

UpdaterProfileId.description: Unique identifier of the user who last updated the customer.
